title: Work order #2291 filed
description: A maintenance request is submitted from the Lab 2 desk: service the Storage Room camera recorder at 21:10 that night.

title: Dr. Voss leaves the building
description: Maren Voss badges out through the lobby turnstile.

title: Victor Lang drives out
description: The managing director's car leaves the garage barrier. It does not return.

title: Alex Reyes badges out
description: Reyes leaves through the lobby turnstile carrying a large duffel bag that looks empty.

title: The lobby desk is left empty
description: Nina Okafor leaves her chair after a call from the hospital. The lobby is unattended for twenty minutes.

title: Garage stairwell door opens
description: Card 0331 opens the garage stairwell door, a route that bypasses the lobby turnstile and camera.

title: Storage Room camera goes dark
description: A remote modem session puts the Storage Room CCTV recorder into service mode. It stops recording.

title: Storage Room B opened
description: Card 0331 opens the Storage Room B door. It closes five minutes later.

title: Okafor returns to her post
description: The pressure mat registers the guard back at her desk. Nothing is logged for the missing twenty minutes.

title: Camera recorder resumes
description: The Storage Room recorder returns to record mode. The prior thirty minutes are blank.

title: Reyes's car leaves the garage
description: Permit A-117 exits the barrier. A duffel bag sits on the passenger seat, visibly fuller than before.

title: The empty case is discovered
description: Dr. Voss opens Storage Room B and finds the Argus-7 case empty. Security is alerted; the case is opened.
